cases.description: On a fresh sync.Once, if the first function panics, the panic propagates; after recovery, a later Do returns without calling its function.
When the first Do function has started and is blocked, a concurrent Do cannot return until the first function finishes, and the second function is not called.
On an empty bytes.Buffer, Read(nil) returns (0,nil) while Read with a one-byte destination returns (0,io.EOF).

After ReadByte succeeds on a nonempty bytes.Buffer, a zero-length Read returns (0,nil) and prevents UnreadByte from succeeding; after a subsequent successful ReadByte, UnreadByte succeeds and permits reading that same byte again.
